title: filename not sanitised: path traversal risk not guarded at API boundary
description: ReassembledFile::filename (reassemble.rs:20) is documented as 'not sanitised' with a note that callers should validate against path-traversal patterns. However the filename comes directly from the UU begin line via uuencoding::decode, and real-world UU archives have been observed with filenames containing '../' sequences. The security note is present (reassemble.rs:19-20) but it is only in the field's doc comment, not in the reassemble() function doc, not in the crate-level doc, and not in the README security section. The README security section (line 93-95) only mentions decompression bombs. A caller reading only the README would not know the filename needs sanitisation. Minimum fix: add explicit path-traversal warning to the reassemble() function docs and to the README security section.
